name: Uproot
body:
School transmutation; Level adept 2, druid 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, M (a small cutting from the targeted plants)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target inanimate plants of Large-size or smaller which are completely enclosed in one location (up to a 10-ft. cube/level)
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You take hold of plants within the area, uproot them, and disentangle them from any surface. You may target all plants within the area of effect, or only some specific types of plants. The targeted plants extrude their roots from soil, cracks and crevices in masonry, or wherever else they have found purchase. The plants fall to the ground in a heap, otherwise undamaged.
